name: Nova
tagline: The line between your work and your resume.

description.project: Create a resume tailored for any job using your Github.
description.technical: Fullstack, Typesafe NextJS, Postgres app allowing you to create job specific resumes using your github repos and LLM for tailoring your work to job description

features.name: Github OAuth
features.description: Using Github OAuth to read repos.
features.implementation: Better Auth's OAuth functionality with scope changes

features.name: AI Powered Tailoring
features.description: Using LLM Models to analyze job description and tailor a resume for it.
features.implementation: OpenRouter API with auto LLM model and a chain of conversations, 3 with stages of analysis, tailoring projects and tailoring resume

highlights: Use of Github OAuth to read user repos
